title: Noeis — Grow a knowledge base from what you read
description: Save what you read, write down what you believe, and Noeis checks one against the other: every passage for or against your view, quoted, and a wiki that cites its sources and shows where they disagree.
eyebrow: A knowledge base that argues back
headline: Know when your reading disagrees with you.
lede: Save what you read, write down what you believe, and Noeis checks one against the other. It quotes every passage for or against a view you hold, tells you when a new source pushes back, and grows a wiki that cites its sources and shows where they disagree.

specimen.label: What it looks like
specimen.view: Teams that write things down make better decisions than teams that meet.
specimen.against: A source you saved pushes against this
specimen.quote: Written proposals reward the fluent writer. The quiet engineer with the right answer loses the argument on the page.
specimen.source: An essay in your library, saved on Tuesday

statements.title: Hold a view, and let your reading test it.
statements.copy: Write what you believe in one sentence. Noeis reads what you have already saved against it, and everything you save after, and quotes each passage for or against. Nothing is filed until you say so.

statements.title: Hear when a new source pushes back.
statements.copy: When something you save argues with a view you hold, Noeis names the source and quotes it the next time you open it. You decide whether it counts.

statements.title: A wiki that shows where sources disagree.
statements.copy: Pages are built from your articles, highlights and notes, and cite them. Where two sources disagree, the page says so and asks which you believe.

statements.title: Ask, and get your own reading back.
statements.copy: Questions are answered from your library with the quote. When your reading has nothing on it, Noeis says so instead of guessing. Connect Claude Code, Codex and other agents, read-only unless you grant more.
